== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Magisters are a prominent guild categorized as an Imperialist faction, alongside the [[Blackwatch]], Navigators, and the [[Imperial Guard]]. While many members of the guild are scholars and researchers, the organization has also been known to train specialized assassins. The guild is characterized by its members' use of staves, which serve as tools to channel potent natural forces—such as plants, [[Elders]], or the powers of [[Kameira]]—through their [[Intent]]. This ability allows them to perform extraordinary feats, including manipulating weather, growing forests, or incinerating objects. Magisters are recognized for their intense [[Intent]], which can be felt as a physical heat or weight. Their staves are often unique to the individual, sometimes decorated with crystals, jewels, or specific materials like [[Iron|iron]] or charred wood. The guild is led by a [[Blackwatch Guild Head|Guild Head]]; [[Mekendi Maxeus]], an instructor at the [[Imperial]] Academy known for wearing a painted black [[The mask|mask]], served in this capacity. Following his death, the guild has remained without an appointed leader, potentially waiting for the outcome of ongoing inter-guild conflicts. The guild maintains its own research journals and historical records, which are studied by its members.}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|As members of the Imperialist alliance, the Magisters began gathering together after sensing an approaching threat. This group works toward the goal of protecting the people and possesses the knowledge required to explain how [[Reading]] is utilized to [[Awaken]] [[stone]]. In response to the growing danger, they have begun collecting weapons.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Magisters]] are gathering because they sense something coming.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c6">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Magisters]] are part of the Imperialist alliance.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Magisters]] are a group working to protect the people.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c14">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Magisters]] can explain how [[Reading]] is used to [[Awaken]] [[stone]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c16">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 16</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Magisters]] are gathering weapons.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c18">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Magisters possess the ability to collaborate on the construction of boxes designed to seal [[Vessels]] and can successfully hide their [[Intent]] from [[Reading]]. As members of a panel formed by [[Calder]] to counter various reports, they also orchestrated the theft of pseudo-[[Gardeners]] trained by [[Rudeus Maxwell|Maxwell]]. During a confrontation in the streets of the [[Imperial]] Palace, they unleashed their powers as part of an army facing [[Shera]] and [[Meia]]. This conflict follows a previous attempt by [[Darius Allbright|Darius]] to prevent [[Shera]] from killing the Magisters.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Magisters]] can collaborate on creating boxes to seal [[Vessels]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c4">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Magisters]] unleashed their powers in the streets of the [[Imperial]] Palace.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Magisters]] are part of an army facing [[Shera]] and [[Meia]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Magisters]] stole pseudo-[[Gardeners]] trained by [[Rudeus Maxwell|Maxwell]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Magisters]] are part of a panel formed by [[Calder]] to counter reports.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Magisters]] can hide [[Intent]] from [[Reading]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c15">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Darius Allbright|Darius]] had previously tried to stop [[Shera]] from killing [[Magisters]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
